# German cargo supplementary plate fixtures

- `vzkat-30.png`, `vzkat-31.png`, and `vzkat-wet.png` are face crops from page 18 of the [official German sign catalogue, part 7](https://www.verwaltungsvorschriften-im-internet.de/pdf/BMVBW-S32-0001-KF10-BS-A007.pdf). The synthetic `stack-*` scenes combine those faces with the shared DE:274-50 pictogram on a flat background.
- `dobel.png` is a crop of a [StreetShots photo by uploader `admin`](https://images.streetshots.io/api/pictures/5aed623a-f68c-4d0d-8223-39394cfc56a3), licensed [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). The crop is shared under the same license. The speed-board box in the crop is `(31, 28, 34, 35)` in top-left pixel coordinates.

The fixtures are test resources. The apps run classification on source pixels and receive no fixture coordinates, map location, or expected sign code.
